The entire presidential command is one coupled exemption from section 204 and continuance in service, both limited until August 1, 1937; the exact verified ending span is 1325-1386. The statutory quotation is recited authority and the retirement-age recital supplies context, not an independent surviving command. The direct calendar limit ends this legal grant without proof of actual service through the cap. Neither the complete original nor the supplied continuation establishes a concrete earlier condition terminating that legal grant. Earlier death, retirement or separation is not established and could affect actual service or use of the exemption; no uninterrupted service, actual retirement date or biographical event is inferred. The complete EO 7629 text (chars 0-1512), signed June 8, 1937, identifies the same person and position and expressly recites EO 7420 of July 20, 1936. It independently grants a further exemption and continuance until August 1, 1938, without expressly revoking, rewriting, shortening or extending EO 7420's own text. Neither its signing date nor its later cap is EO 7420's first legal cessation. No independent office, continuing rule, post-term command or express savings provision appears. Compensation or credit actually earned would be accrued effects, not continuing operative authority; their existence is not proved. Thus the single-clause inventory, whole-order own-terms ending on August 1, 1937 and no operative status at the October 14, 2026 cutoff are supported within the stated bounded searches. The own_terms_until_event label describes this calendar limitation, not contingent performance. The inclusive-until convention is qualified by the disclosed exclusive boundary alternative. No current continuing predicate needs proof for an already expired fixed grant, and no statutory continuity or universal negative search finding is inferred.
